summary: Measure NRW, assess DMAs, and prioritise leakage and meter-loss interventions. Explore the practical five-day course and enquire about team delivery.
lede: Non-revenue water analytics helps utility managers, network engineers, and revenue teams quantify water losses and assess practical responses. Participants build and validate water balances, review district-metered area and minimum night flow data, check meter records, and assess pressure management and leakage-control options. They also compare interventions using cost-benefit and payback calculations, with SCADA, AMI, GIS, and reporting tools covered as operational data sources and aids.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support water-loss, network, revenue, and infrastructure investment decisions across utility operations and related programmes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water-utility operations or water-distribution terminology is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to work through spreadsheet exercises; Power BI is discussed as a reporting option, but no software installation or licence is specified.
